tools.name: decimalpos_list_products
tools.description: List products (item catalog: code, description, price, stock) sorted by product id. Costs 1 credit per request. Use lastMod for incremental sync. Requires the product:get scope.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its numeric id. Costs 1 credit. Unit price = price ÷ priceQty. Requires product:get.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_product_by_code
tools.description: Get one product by its SKU or item code (UPC). Costs 1 credit. Requires product:get.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_customers
tools.description: List all customers, sorted by last change. Needs customer:get with all access (a sensitive scope; an own-access key gets 403). Costs 1 credit per request. Personal data: request only what the task needs.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id (name, contact, address). Costs 1 credit. Requires customer:get.

tools.name: decimalpos_find_customer_by_phone
tools.description: Find one customer by phone number (10 digits). Costs 1 credit. Requires customer:get.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its internal id, with items and payment. Free. Only orders created with this key.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_order_by_external_id
tools.description: Get one order by the external order id your system set. Free. Only orders created with this key.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its id, with lines, taxes and payments. Free. Only invoices of orders created with this key.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_invoice_for_order
tools.description: Get the invoice of one order by the order's internal id. Free.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_invoice_by_external_order_id
tools.description: Get the invoice of one order by the external order id your system set. Free.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_invoice_by_external_invoice_id
tools.description: Get one invoice by the external invoice id your system set. Free.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_sale_permissions
tools.description: List the item codes this key may query for sale history (GET /permissionlist). Free. Needs the store owner's sale-record grant; an empty list returns 403.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_sale_records
tools.description: List invoice lines that sold one item in a date window (max 31 days). Costs 0.1 credit per row. The itemCode must be on the permission list. Sale lines carry no ticket total.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_ticket_item_quantity
tools.description: Get how many units of one item were sold on one ticket (net of returns). Costs 1 credit. A missing ticket or line returns quantity 0.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_vendors
tools.description: List suppliers, ordered by vendor code. Costs 1 credit per request. Needs the vendor:get scope with all access.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by its vendor code, with address, contact and payment terms. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_vendor_products
tools.description: List one vendor's catalog: item numbers, pack sizes and prices (pricedPer Case or Each). Costs 1 credit per request. Paginated: send cursor back unchanged.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_bills
tools.description: List vendor bills (purchase invoices) with items; credit memos included. Free. Only bills created with this key. Send the same filters with every cursor.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_bill
tools.description: Get one vendor bill by id, with items, amounts paid and balance. Free. Only bills created with this key.

tools.name: decimalpos_find_bills_by_invoice_number
tools.description: Find every bill with one vendor's invoice number. Free. Returns all matches; 404 when none.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_payment_terms
tools.description: List every payment terms code the store defined (for example NET30), in one page. Costs 1 credit.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "decimalpos_get_product_by_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: decimalpos_list_sale_records, decimalpos_get_ticket_item_quantity · Private data: decimalpos_get_customer, decimalpos_list_sale_permissions, decimalpos_list_sale_records, decimalpos_get_vendor · Public sink: decimalpos_list_vendor_products, decimalpos_list_bills.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: decimalpos_list_sale_records, decimalpos_get_ticket_item_quantity · Private data: decimalpos_get_customer, decimalpos_list_sale_permissions, decimalpos_list_sale_records, decimalpos_get_vendor · Public sink: decimalpos_list_vendor_products, decimalpos_list_bills

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
